name: bistro
title: Bistro
description: A restaurant and café theme where the menu is the one designed object — a printed carte with a thick-and-thin ruled frame, course headings, dot leaders and tabular prices, in bottle green and wine on linen, turning to chalk on a green board after dark.

tokens.--font-display: site title, headings, dish names, course names — the narrow capital letters of a shop sign
tokens.--font-body: body text and menu descriptions — the printed-menu voice
tokens.--font-mono: inline code and code blocks in page text
tokens.--tracking-display: letter spacing in headings, dish names and prices
tokens.--tracking-caps: wider letter spacing in the small capital labels: menu links, course names, hours labels, the reserve button
tokens.--color-bg: page background (the tablecloth by day, the wall at night)
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: dish descriptions, hours labels, dates, the footer
tokens.--color-accent: links, prices, course names, and focus rings
tokens.--color-cta: the reserve button, and the small wine-red mark under each course name and the current menu link
tokens.--color-paper: the carte and the hours card (paper by day, the green board at night)
tokens.--color-frame: the ruled frame of the carte and the hours card, and the rules under the masthead and above the footer
tokens.--color-leader: the dot leaders between a dish and its price, and between an hours label and its time
tokens.--color-border: thin dividing lines: between posts, in tables, above the note at the foot of the carte
tokens.--shadow-carte: the soft shadow that lifts the carte and the hours card off the page
tokens.--measure: maximum width of the text column, masthead and footer
tokens.--measure-carte: width of the menu card on the menu page
tokens.--radius: corner rounding on the carte, the hours card, the reserve button and images
tokens.--rule: weight of the heavy rules: the card frames, under the masthead, above the footer, and the leader dots
tokens.--frame-gap: space between the heavy rule and the hairline beside it
tokens.--space-1: hairline gap: between a dish name and its description, under a small label
tokens.--space-2: small gap: between a dish name, its leader and its price
tokens.--space-3: page gutter on small screens, and the gap between dishes
tokens.--space-4: gap between blocks, and the space above the masthead
tokens.--space-5: large gap above page titles and above the footer
